specsSection.title: Liner system specifications
specsSection.description: Liners directly affect burn room safety and service life. Our engineered materials and structure isolate heat and minimize thermal loss.

specs.value: Interlocking assembly; each panel independently replaceable
Withstands repeated Class A live-fire training temperatures
Significantly reduces steel back-face temperature; protects primary structure
Local damage repaired by replacing individual panels—no full tear-out
For fixed towers and modular system burn rooms

features: Interlocking structure for faster installation and replacement
Calcium-silicate material balances durability and insulation
Protects primary burn room steel structure and extends service life
Retrofit upgrades for existing burn rooms

performanceSection.title: Built for demanding live-fire conditions
performanceSection.description: From material to construction, our liner systems are built for repeated live-fire training—protecting structure, supporting realism, and simplifying maintenance.

performance: Protects metal, masonry, and concrete structures
Suitable for new construction, retrofits, and damaged-structure repair
Realistic drywall appearance for training realism
Works well with thermal imaging cameras
Supports Class A and gas-simulation fires
No restriction on fire source placement inside the burn room
No freeze-thaw issues; no drying period between sessions
Does not promote mold growth; does not absorb water
